sources.title: Second-order cone representation for convex subsets of the plane
sources.claim: Abstract states that every closed convex semialgebraic subset of R2 has second-order cone representability. Abstract/metadata read only; no proof or complexity bound audited.
sources.classification: known mathematical manuscript, not new2026 publication or product announcement

own_application: The fixedc0,r slice is convex by convex combinations of quadrant analytic maps with the same anchor, semialgebraic by the quartic, and closed/bounded via F<=0 and the positive eigenvector branch. Thus general planar representability was already covered by these prior statements; explicit small matrices remain only a scoped elementary construction. The variablec body has3real variables and is not covered by the quoted planar theorem.
decision: Reject a generic planar-SDP or SOC-existence novelty claim and do not create a minor paper. Full prior proofs not audited.
